{{Quote|Coryx Moth is on patrol near Falleen, is she not?|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Coryx Moth''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class star destroyer]] which fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
This ship was patrolling around the planet [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] during the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year of the war]] when it received a request from Republic forces fighting the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Second Battle of Kothlis]]. Jumping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to reinforce them, this ship helped win the battle.
